lines.en: label mollycafe15:
scene mollyoutside1
It’s a cold winter night, as is customary for...winter.
lines.zh: 这是一个寒冷的冬夜，按惯例来说……冬天嘛。

lines.en: Let me start over.
lines.zh: 让我重来一遍。

lines.en: That was a horrible introduction to my nightly activities.
lines.zh: 这个开场白，对我今晚的行踪来说真是糟透了。

lines.en: I make my way to the cafe to see what Molly is up to because I guess I’m in the mood to be confused tonight or something.
lines.zh: 我往咖啡馆走去，想看看 Molly 在忙些什么，大概是因为今晚我不知怎么地就是想找点困惑来受。

lines.en: I suppose I just subconsciously enjoy spending time with her despite being at a complete disadvantage in around 100%% of our conversations.
lines.zh: 我想，尽管我们在大约 100%% 的对话里我都处于彻底劣势，但我潜意识里就是喜欢和她待在一起。

lines.en: Hell, I can’t even say something like “At least she’s fun” because, frankly, I don’t really {i}know{/i} how I feel around her.
lines.zh: 见鬼，我甚至说不出「至少她很有趣」这种话，因为坦白讲，我根本不{i}清楚{/i}自己在她身边是什么感受。

lines.en: Unique is a better word than fun, in her case.
lines.zh: 对她而言，「独特」是比「有趣」更贴切的词。

lines.en: But, then again, unique is the catch-all word you use to describe people that don't fit in.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，「独特」也是你用来形容那些格格不入的人的万能词。

lines.en: People with unclear sets of circumstances and ideals that have equally unclear outlooks on what people should enjoy or despise.
lines.zh: 那些处境与理想都模糊不清的人，对人们该喜欢什么、该厌恶什么，看法也同样模糊不清。

lines.en: Unique used to be a bad character trait.
lines.zh: 「独特」在过去算是个糟糕的性格特质。

lines.en: People used to be made fun of for not conforming.
lines.zh: 不合群的人曾经会被人嘲笑。

lines.en: But now it’s a sort of goal.
lines.zh: 可如今它成了一种追求。

lines.en: A finicky goal, but a goal nonetheless.
lines.zh: 一个挑剔的追求，但终究是个追求。

lines.en: You want to be unique, but not {i}so{/i} unique that you scare people away.
lines.zh: 你想变得独特，但又不能{i}独特到{/i}把别人吓跑。

lines.en: I think this is what Molly struggles with.
lines.zh: 我想这正是 Molly 挣扎的地方。

lines.en: She hasn’t managed to scare me away yet, but she also seems to enjoy my class a lot more than her last one.
lines.zh: 她还没能把我也吓跑，不过她似乎也比我接手之前更喜欢我这个班了。

lines.en: I wonder if they thought she may have been a little too unique as well?
lines.zh: 我在想，他们是不是也觉得她有点太独特了？

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: But, somehow or another, her existence was enough to compel me to come here, of all places, in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: 但不管怎么说，她的存在足以驱使我，在三更半夜跑到这个地方来。

lines.en: The middle of this cold, winter night.
lines.zh: 在这个寒冷冬夜的正中间。

lines.en: As is customary for winter.
lines.zh: 按惯例来说，冬天嘛。

lines.en: scene mollyoutside2
I find her seated outside of the cafe under the glow of a streetlight, closing her eyes and waiting for her coffee to cool off.
lines.zh: 我发现她坐在咖啡馆门外、路灯的光晕之下，闭着眼睛，等她的咖啡凉下来。

lines.en: It’s rare seeing her without a fiery glare of determination or fists clenched out of passion for some...anime character or...paladin or other things she’s brought up throughout our brief time together.
lines.zh: 很少见她没有那副燃烧着决心的灼灼目光，也没有因为某个……动漫角色，或者……圣骑士，或者我们短暂相处中她提过的别的什么东西，而激动地攥紧拳头。

lines.en: And, strangely enough, despite being stripped of all of those qualities you can easily melt into her industrial grade pot of uniqueness-
lines.zh: 而且说来奇怪，尽管她身上那些特质全被剥了个干净，你却能轻易地融化进她那锅工业级浓度的独特之中——

lines.en: She looks more natural than ever.
lines.zh: 她看起来比任何时候都自然。

lines.en: : Have you blessed yourself tonight, Sir?
lines.zh: : 您今晚为自己祈福了吗，先生？

lines.en: : Oh. You knew I was here.
lines.zh: : 哦。你知道我在这儿。

lines.en: : You have a distinct aura that only someone with my affinity for holy magic is able to sense.
lines.zh: : 您身上有一种独特的气息，只有像我这样对神圣魔法有亲和力的人才感觉得到。

lines.en: : Does that holy aura or whatever have something to do with you asking if I’ve blessed myself?
lines.zh: : 那这什么神圣气息，跟你问我有没祈福有什么关系吗？

lines.en: : Nay.
lines.zh: : 非也。

lines.en: : I ask because the moon is but a child.
lines.zh: : 我这么问，是因为月亮还只是个孩子。

lines.en: : Have you looked up at all in the last several hours, Sir?
lines.zh: : 这几个小时里，您抬头看过天吗，先生？

lines.en: : ...Probably?
lines.zh: : ……大概吧？

lines.en: : That’s not something I normally keep track of.
lines.zh: : 这种事我一般不会特意去记。

lines.en: scene mollyoutside3
: There’s an old Irish superstition that says if you don’t bless yourself whenever you see a new moon, bad luck is sure to befall you.
lines.zh: : 爱尔兰有个古老的迷信说法：看见新月时如果没有为自己祈福，厄运必定降临到头上。

lines.en: : But of course, it’s just a superstition...and those aren’t always true.
lines.zh: : 不过当然，那只是迷信罢了……而迷信也不总是灵验。

lines.en: scene mollyoutside4
: For example, I didn’t even drop a fork today and you still showed up.
lines.zh: : 比如说，我今天连叉子都没掉过，可您还是出现了。

lines.en: : Ireland is weird.
lines.zh: : 爱尔兰真是个奇怪的地方。

lines.en: : Of course, Sir. What other country could have possibly birthed a girl like me?
lines.zh: : 那当然，先生。除了我国，还有哪个国家能生出我这样的女孩呢？

lines.en: : I take it this weather is fine for you as well, then?
lines.zh: : 这么说来，这种天气对您来说也算舒适吧？

lines.en: : Are you struggling with the cold, Sir?
lines.zh: : 您是不是冻得够呛，先生？

lines.en: : Come! Embrace me! Share in my warmth!
lines.zh: : 来吧！抱住我！分享我的体温！

lines.en: scene mollyoutside5
: But yes. I actually think it’s rather nice tonight.
lines.zh: : 不过没错。我觉得今晚其实挺舒服的。

lines.en: : The perfect temperature to go on an adventure, even.
lines.zh: : 甚至可以说是出门冒险的完美气温。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, my legs are far too weak and my body far too frail to embark on such a thing.
lines.zh: : 可惜我的双腿太虚弱、身体太孱弱，实在无法踏上那样的旅程。

lines.en: : I shall confine myself to this bench instead, waiting patiently for my true love to return to me.
lines.zh: : 我只能把自己困在这张长椅上，耐心等待我的真爱回到我身边。

lines.en: : And your true love is?
lines.zh: : 那你的真爱是？

lines.en: scene mollyoutside6
: Kagome Higurashi...
lines.zh: : 日暮戈薇……

lines.en: : But she is a story for another day...
lines.zh: : 不过那就是另一个故事了……

lines.en: : Anime character, I’m guessing?
lines.zh: : 我猜是个动漫角色？

lines.en: scene mollyoutside7
: I refuse to believe that it’s possible to have a first love who {i}isn’t{/i} some type of cartoon character.
lines.zh: : 我拒绝相信，会有谁的初恋{i}不是{/i}某种卡通角色。

lines.en: : Weren’t you particularly fond of a certain sailor scout, Sir? That’s what Ami claims, at least.
lines.zh: : 您以前不是特别喜欢某位水手战士吗，先生？至少 Ami 是这么说的。

lines.en: : Hey, Molly. Here’s an idea-
lines.zh: : 嘿，Molly。我有个主意——

lines.en: : How about we talk about normal human stuff tonight instead of...whatever {i}you're{/i} talking about.
lines.zh: : 今晚我们聊点正常人聊的东西怎么样，别再聊……{i}你{/i}那些有的没的。

lines.en: scene mollyoutside8
: But I already used up all of my human knowledge when I told you about new moons and forks.
lines.zh: : 可我把新月和叉子的事讲完，我的人类知识就已经用光了呀。

lines.en: : Why is your human knowledge limited to such strangely specific things?
lines.zh: : 为什么你的人类知识只限于这么奇怪又具体的东西？

lines.en: : Because I wiped everything else clear to make room for more otaku stuff.
lines.zh: : 因为我把其他东西全清空了，好腾出地方装更多御宅族的东西。

lines.en: : Besides, every conversation I’ve ever tried to have about life with Japanese people has fallen even flatter than my chest.
lines.zh: : 再说，我每次试着跟日本人聊人生，聊出来的效果都比我的胸部还要平。

lines.en: : That sounds pretty bad.
lines.zh: : 听起来挺惨的。

lines.en: : It is, Sir. I am very much banking on you being a lolicon.
lines.zh: : 确实如此，先生。我现在可是把宝全押在您是个萝莉控上了。

lines.en: : Without divulging any additional information about my feelings on that matter, what’s so different about Japanese people compared to the Irish?
lines.zh: : 关于这件事我的想法就不多透露了，那么日本人和爱尔兰人到底有什么不同？

lines.en: scene mollyoutside9
: Are you truly asking that?
lines.zh: : 您真的要问这个？

lines.en: : That’s like asking about the difference between a warlock and mage.
lines.zh: : 这就好比问术士和法师有什么区别。

lines.en: : Are those not the same thing?
lines.zh: : 那不是同一个东西吗？

lines.en: scene mollyoutside10
: No! Not even close! I’m offended that you’d even say something like that!
lines.zh: : 不是！差远了！您居然说得出这种话，真是让我感到被冒犯了！

lines.en: : Mages are masters of the arcane arts and stupid warlocks get all their stupid powers from a stupid god! It’s barely even magic!
lines.zh: : 法师是奥术的大师，而愚蠢的术士所有愚蠢的力量都来自某个愚蠢的神！那根本算不上魔法！

lines.en: : Maybe you should drink your coffee, Molly.
lines.zh: : Molly，你还是喝口咖啡吧。

lines.en: : Isn’t caffeine good at helping people with...ADHD or whatever?
lines.zh: : 咖啡因不是对……多动症之类的有帮助吗？

lines.en: scene mollyoutside11
: I have also heard that. But you can't just go around bringing up people's conditions like that, Sir.
lines.zh: : 我也听说过这种说法。但您不能就这么随随便便把人家的病症挂在嘴边啊，先生。

lines.en: : You’re going to hurt someone’s feelings that way.
lines.zh: : 您这样是会伤到别人的。

lines.en: scene mollyoutside12
: However!
lines.zh: : 不过呢！

lines.en: : I have become excellent at shielding myself from what {i}actual{/i} humans say!
lines.zh: : 我已经练就了一身绝技，能把{i}活{/i}人说出的话全都屏蔽掉！

lines.en: : I will be completely fine as long as I don’t read it through a textbox on the bottom third of my computer screen!
lines.zh: : 只要不是显示在电脑屏幕下面三分之一的文本框里，我就完全没事！

lines.en: : And since the night is just as [young]as the moon above, I suppose I wouldn’t mind educating you on what makes people like me different from people like you.
lines.zh: : 既然这个夜晚和头顶的月亮一样[young]，我想我不介意给您讲讲，像我这样的人和像您这样的人到底哪里不同。

lines.en: : And I’m not just talking about our celestial affinities! Hahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 而且我说的可不只限于我们的天体亲和性！哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Haha...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……

lines.en: Our celestial what?
lines.zh: 我们的天体什么？

lines.en: scene mollyoutside13
: What is the first thing that comes to your mind when you think of Ireland, Sir?
lines.zh: : 您一想到爱尔兰，脑海里最先浮现的是什么，先生？

lines.en: : I’d be willing to wager that it’s either potatoes or alcohol, am I correct?
lines.zh: : 我敢打赌，不是土豆就是酒，我说得对吗？

lines.en: : Hey, you said it. Not me.
lines.zh: : 嘿，这话可是你说的，不是我。

lines.en: : The fact of the matter is, there are stereotypes.
lines.zh: : 事实上，刻板印象是存在的。

lines.en: : And being a girl implanted from another country, and one who was dedicated enough to learn the language and culture for the sake of my hobbies-
lines.zh: : 而我这个从异国被移植过来的女孩，还为了自己的爱好，足够用心地去学了这里的语言和文化——

lines.en: : I’m definitely impressed by that, by the way. I’m not sure if I’ve told you that before.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，我真的挺佩服这点的。我不记得以前有没有跟你说过。

lines.en: scene mollyoutside14
: Ah-
: Well, umm...Thank you, Sir.
lines.zh: : 这个，嗯……谢谢您，先生。

lines.en: : But...umm...
scene mollyoutside15
: Like I was saying, there are a bunch of other stereotypes or...stuff people expect that just isn’t always true.
lines.zh: : 就像我刚才说的，还有很多别的刻板印象，或者……人们对你的期待，其实并不总是真的。

lines.en: : Like how the Irish are all liars or that they’re violent and...don’t have access to Internet or television.
lines.zh: : 比如说爱尔兰人都是骗子，或者都很暴力，还有……连网络和电视都没有。

lines.en: : You never really understand what people think about you until you go somewhere you don’t fit in.
lines.zh: : 你永远不会真正明白别人是怎么看你的，除非你去到一个自己格格不入的地方。

lines.en: : But, at the same time, stereotypes exist for reasons and they don’t just come out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 但话又说回来，刻板印象的存在是有原因的，它们不会凭空冒出来。

lines.en: scene mollyoutside16
: Like...like goblins! Or dwarves!
lines.zh: : 就像……就像哥布林！或者矮人！

lines.en: : What do you think of when you hear those things, Sir?!
lines.zh: : 您听到这些词会想到什么，先生？！

lines.en: : That they’re short.
lines.zh: : 它们个子矮。

lines.en: scene mollyoutside17
: Oh.
: Well, yeah. That’s true.
lines.zh: : 嗯，对。这倒是真的。

lines.en: : But anyone with even mild exposure to fantasy would say things like goblins are greedy and dwarves are masculine and spend all their time blacksmithing.
lines.zh: : 但哪怕只是稍微接触过奇幻作品的人，都会说哥布林贪婪、矮人阳刚，整天就知道打铁。

lines.en: : Point is, people like me are just like dwarves or goblins in a place like this.
lines.zh: : 重点是，在这样一个地方，像我这样的人就跟矮人或者哥布林一样。

lines.en: : I was raised a certain way and grew up surrounded by cultures and traditions that wouldn’t make sense here.
lines.zh: : 我是被那样养大的，在那些到了这里根本说不通的文化和传统中长大。

lines.en: : I still have a hard time remembering to take my shoes off inside or how I'm supposed to call out to servers at restaurants.
lines.zh: : 我到现在还老是记不住进屋要脱鞋，也不知道在餐厅该怎么招呼服务员。

lines.en: : And if you threw a Japanese person into the Emerald Isle, they’d feel just as out of place.
lines.zh: : 要是把一个日本人扔到翡翠岛上，他一样会觉得格格不入。

lines.en: : The fact that I speak in...constant reference to things that even most Japanese don’t understand just makes things even harder for me.
lines.zh: : 而我说话时总是……不停地引用连大多数日本人都听不懂的东西，这就让我的处境更加艰难了。

lines.en: : If life’s a game, I’m basically playing on the hardest difficulty right now.
lines.zh: : 如果人生是一场游戏，那我现在基本就是在打最高难度。

lines.en: : Like Ornstein & Smough, except there are two Ornsteins and five Smoughs.
lines.zh: : 就像翁斯坦与斯摩，只不过是两个翁斯坦和五个斯摩。

lines.en: : Are those...anime characters as well?
lines.zh: : 那些也是……动漫角色吗？

lines.en: scene mollyoutside18
: You have...so much to learn, Sir.
lines.zh: : 您……要学的东西还多着呢，先生。

lines.en: : So much to learn.
lines.zh: : 多着呢。

lines.en: : Apparently so.
lines.zh: : 看来是这样。

lines.en: : I can’t really attest to what it must be like being “implanted” here, like you put it-
lines.zh: : 我没法真正体会你所说的「被移植」到这里是什么感觉——

lines.en: : But even though you’re weird and draw way too much attention to yourself and talk too loudly pretty much all the time-
lines.zh: : 但是，尽管你很怪，总是把太多的注意力吸引到自己身上，而且几乎每时每刻说话都太大声——

lines.en: : Are you just...going to keep listing the things you don’t like about me?
lines.zh: : 你是打算……就这么一直数落你不喜欢我的地方吗？

lines.en: : And you always cause a commotion in class and never make me any of the things I order inside of the cafe and-
lines.zh: : 而且你老是在课堂上闹腾，我在咖啡馆里点的东西你从来没给我做过，还有——

lines.en: scene mollyoutside19
: When does it end?!
lines.zh: : 什么时候才是个头啊？！

lines.en: : And all of the other things I find annoying about you-
lines.zh: : 还有所有那些让我觉得你很烦的地方——

lines.en: : AHHHHHHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: : I think you’re doing great.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你做得很好。

lines.en: : AHHHHH FINE, I’LL TRY TO CUT DOWN ON-
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊行吧，我会尽量改——

lines.en: scene mollyoutside20
: Wait, repeat that last part. I was so torn up inside that I drowned it out with my fury.
lines.zh: : 等等，把最后那句再说一遍。我当时心里太崩溃，用怒火把它盖过去了。

lines.en: : I think you’re doing great.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你做得很好。

lines.en: : I mean, my life was a lot easier before you showed up, but it’s not like I’d get rid of you if I had the choice now.
lines.zh: : 我是说，你出现之前我的生活轻松多了，但就算现在让我选，我也不会把你从我的生活里赶走。

lines.en: : So yeah, we’re different. Complete opposites even, but-
lines.zh: : 所以没错，我们不一样。甚至是完全相反的两个人，不过——

lines.en: : But opposites attract...
lines.zh: : 但相异相吸……

lines.en: : Yeah. That.
lines.zh: : 嗯。就是这个。

lines.en: scene mollyoutside21
: Am I...
lines.zh: : 我是不是……

lines.en: : Am I on the Sensei route already?!
lines.zh: : 我已经进入 Sensei 路线了吗？！

lines.en: : Are you in love with me?!
lines.zh: : 您爱上我了吗？！

lines.en: : I’m not in love with you.
lines.zh: : 我没有爱上你。

lines.en: scene mollyoutside22
: Oh.
: F’s in chat for the Irish girl. Please and thank you.
lines.zh: : 弹幕里给这位爱尔兰女孩刷个 F 吧。谢谢各位了。

lines.en: : Just because I’m not in love with you doesn’t mean I don’t want to spend more time with you, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，我没有爱上你，并不代表我不想多花点时间和你在一起。

lines.en: : It’s a cold winter night and, instead of going inside and getting a hot beverage, I’ve stayed out here talking about Irish stereotypes and...warlocks.
lines.zh: : 这是一个寒冷的冬夜，我没有进屋买杯热饮，而是待在外面跟你聊爱尔兰的刻板印象和……术士。

lines.en: scene mollyoutside23
: If you’re not in love with me, can you stop saying things that will cause my puny gamer brain to think you are?
lines.zh: : 既然您没爱上我，能不能别再说那些会让我这颗弱小的玩家大脑误以为您爱我的话？

lines.en: : This isn’t the bad end, is it?
lines.zh: : 这应该不是坏结局吧？

lines.en: : Is this what the friend zone feels like?
lines.zh: : 这就是所谓「朋友区」的感觉吗？

lines.en: : You never even turned in your Cult of Molly paperwork so I can’t even contractually bind you to me as a servant.
lines.zh: : 您连「Molly 教」的入会申请都没交，我都没法用契约把您绑成我的仆人。

lines.en: : Also, don’t get me started on warlocks. I could go on for hours.
lines.zh: : 还有，别让我打开话匣子聊术士。我能聊上好几个小时。

lines.en: : Oh, and if you actually {i}do{/i} want a drink, allow me to purchase it for you so I can use my super awesome employee discount that definitely wasn’t the main selling point to me applying here.
lines.zh: : 哦，对了，如果您{i}真{/i}想喝点什么，请务必让我来买单，好让我用上我那超厉害的员工折扣——当初我来这儿应聘，这一点绝对不是主要动机。

lines.en: : Sure. We'll go in in a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 好啊。我们过几分钟就进去。

lines.en: : Actually, why are you out here anyway? Aren’t you supposed to be working right now?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你到底为什么在外面？你现在不是应该在上班吗？

lines.en: : It looks kind of busy in there tonight.
lines.zh: : 今晚里面看起来挺忙的。

lines.en: scene mollyoutside24
: Hohohoho~ I am out here precisely {i}because{/i} it is busy, Sir.
lines.zh: : 嚯嚯嚯嚯～我之所以待在外面，正是{i}因为{/i}里面忙啊，先生。

lines.en: : Do you truly think someone like me is fit to serve that many customers while the owner herself is working?
lines.zh: : 您真觉得，在老板娘亲自上阵的时候，像我这样的人适合去招呼那么多客人吗？

lines.en: : I would just ruin everything.
lines.zh: : 我只会把一切搞砸。

lines.en: : You seem awfully proud to be bad at your job.
lines.zh: : 你对自己干不好这份工作，好像还挺自豪的。

lines.en: scene mollyoutside25
: I learned from the best.
lines.zh: : 我是跟最厉害的人学的。

lines.en: : There’s this one teacher I have who is utterly horrible at his job and still manages to make the lives of everyone he knows marginally better.
lines.zh: : 我有这么一位老师，工作干得一塌糊涂，却还是能让身边每个人的生活都稍微好上那么一点。

lines.en: Easier, sure. Better? No.
lines.zh: 更轻松，那是。更好？不见得。

lines.en: That’s just not true.
lines.zh: 这话说得不对。

lines.en: : So if I, too, can make everyone’s lives better by never improving, I am ready to lay down my sword and surrender as well.
lines.zh: : 所以，如果我也永远不进步就能让每个人的生活变得更好，那我也准备好放下剑投降了。

lines.en: : Onward to Valhalla, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 向英灵殿进发吧，Sensei。

lines.en: : You, me, and our unearthly desire to be lazy!
lines.zh: : 您、我，还有我们那超凡脱俗的懒惰欲望！

lines.en: Oh my god.
lines.zh: 哦，我的天哪。

lines.en: Am I also a Molly?
lines.zh: 我也是个 Molly 吗？

lines.en: : I feel kind of sick all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 我突然有点想吐。

lines.en: : That’s not illness, Sir. It’s {i}revelation{/i}.
lines.zh: : 那不是生病，先生。那是{i}顿悟{/i}。

lines.en: scene mollyoutside26
: Lay down your weapon! Shelve your armor!
lines.zh: : 放下您的武器！收起您的盔甲！

lines.en: : Today, our battle ends! But our war begins!
lines.zh: : 今天，我们的战斗结束了！但我们的战争才刚刚开始！

lines.en: : For freedom! For love!
lines.zh: : 为了自由！为了爱！

lines.en: : For Ireland!
lines.zh: : 为了爱尔兰！

lines.en: scene black
Molly and I wind up going inside and taking advantage of her employee discount shortly after that.
lines.zh: 没过多久，我和 Molly 就进屋去了，好好享受了一把她的员工折扣。

lines.en: I order a drink directly from Haruka, who places her hand on my shoulder in a show of solidarity for my valiant sacrifice (AKA: spending time with Molly).
lines.zh: 我直接跟 Haruka 点了杯饮料，她把手搭在我肩上，对我这番英勇牺牲（也就是：陪 Molly 消磨时间）表示声援。

lines.en: But, even if I joke-
lines.zh: 不过，即便我是在开玩笑——

lines.en: It isn’t much of a sacrifice.
lines.zh: 这也算不上什么牺牲。

lines.en: I mentioned earlier that I wouldn't describe her as “fun.”
lines.zh: 我前面说过，我不会用「有趣」来形容她。

lines.en: And, in doing that, I was wrong.
lines.zh: 而这么说，我错了。

lines.en: She {i}is{/i} fun.
lines.zh: 她很有趣。

lines.en: Just...
lines.zh: 只是……

lines.en: Not the type of fun I’m used to.
lines.zh: 不是我习惯的那种有趣。

lines.en: And she’s unique as well.
lines.zh: 她也很独特。

lines.en: Just...
lines.zh: 只是……

lines.en: Not the type that’s entirely bad.
lines.zh: 不是那种彻头彻尾糟糕的独特。

$ mollycafe15 = True
{i}Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Molly 的好感度提升到了 [molly_love]!{/i}
